name: Silk (Woven Brocade Detail)
description: Luxurious 3D showcase of woven royal silk. Lustrous flowing crimson-red and obsidian-black silk fabric cascading gracefully from a black lacquer wood spool, with delicate golden crane embroidery threads catching dramatic studio light.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of luxurious woven Japanese silk fabric. Shimmering lustrous deep crimson red (#FF2035) silk cloth cascading from a pitch-black lacquer spool, woven with subtle dark charcoal patterns and fine gold thread accents, smooth satin reflections. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), dramatic crimson rim lighting, hyper-detailed fabric weave, 8k render, no text.
